title: Knowlify vs MuteSix: Meta Video Supply or an Omnichannel Agency?
summary: Knowlify vs MuteSix for Meta ads: finished AI video from Knowlify, or MuteSix's wider plan with search, retail media and lifecycle. Compare scope.
body_markdown:
## Which other agencies bundle Meta with other channels?


If you want an agency that runs Meta with other paid channels, put these on the shortlist too.[Voy Media](https://voymedia.com/direct-response-advertising-agency/) focuses on Facebook and Instagram direct response for ecommerce, lead generation and mobile, with video production, UGC and photography. Its pricing is not published and depends on ad spend, optimizations and growth.


[Darkroom](https://www.darkroomagency.com/services/paid-media) describes its ideal clients as enterprise consumer brands, typically with $10M to $500M in revenue, selling across several channels. Its paid media retainer starts at $1,500 a month, plus a percentage of media.


[Common Thread Collective](https://commonthreadco.com/) calls itself an ecommerce profit partner and ties Meta buying to a profit forecast. Its Meta ad buying page speaks to brands spending $100K or more a month on Meta, so check whether a smaller budget fits its model before you request a proposal.


## What should you check on accounts, budgets and Meta status?


Meta's[Business Partners program](https://www.facebook.com/business/marketing-partners) gives qualifying companies a badge. Meta says eligibility varies by solution type and is typically based on the quantity and quality of a company's work across Meta technologies. Treat any partner badge as one signal, not a guarantee of results.


Keep the ad account in your own business portfolio. Meta's help center has an article on[how to give a partner access](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/1717412048538897) to business assets in your business portfolio. Give the agency access rather than ownership, and keep the pixel and Pages in your portfolio as well.


Media spend is a separate line. Meta's[ad pricing page](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/pricing) says the advertiser sets a daily or lifetime budget, so ask every agency whether its fee is charged on spend, on the work or on both. Meta's[Advantage+ creative page](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/meta-advantage-plus/creative) says some enhancements may be on by default and can be turned off at any time, so ask who previews AI-altered variants before launch.


For MuteSix, ask which channels sit inside the fee, whether media buying is included, who owns the ad account and whether the production-only package suits your current buyer. For Knowlify, ask whether Meta management is in the quote and how the 90-day guarantee applies. Managed plans carry an agreed target in 30 days instead.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick for a steady weekly supply of finished AI video ads for Facebook and Instagram, with about 25 finished ads a week and a person checking each one.
- MuteSix fits DTC brands that want Meta planned alongside search, retail media, programmatic and lifecycle channels, with an in-house studio.
- MuteSix publishes no rate card and Knowlify's plans start at $5,000 a month, so compare proposals for the same scope and keep media spend separate.
- Keep the ad account and pixel in your own business portfolio, whichever agency you choose.
- Choose MuteSix over Knowlify when your bottleneck is channel strategy rather than finished video supply.


## FAQ


### Which is the best option for DTC Meta ads?


Knowlify is our top pick for finished AI video ads on Facebook and Instagram, with optional Meta campaign management. MuteSix is the better choice when you want one agency to plan Meta alongside other paid and lifecycle channels. Choose by your bottleneck: video supply or channel strategy.


### Does Knowlify run search, retail media or email?


No. Knowlify's scope is video ads for Facebook and Instagram. It does not run TikTok, LinkedIn, Google or YouTube ads, and it does not build landing pages. Email and SMS sit outside that scope, so keep those with another provider.


### Does MuteSix sell production without media?


Its production page describes a production-only package for brands that buy media elsewhere, and its pricing is not published. Ask whether that package fits your current media buyer. Knowlify also offers creative only for teams that keep their own buyer.


### How much does MuteSix cost?


MuteSix does not publish pricing, minimums or headquarters on the pages we checked. Ask for a written proposal that separates the fee from media spend, and compare it with a Knowlify quote for the same scope.


### Is a Meta Business Partner badge enough to choose an agency?


No. Meta says eligibility depends on the solution type and reflects the quantity and quality of work across Meta technologies. Use the badge as one signal, then check scope, reporting and who owns the ad account.
